work_items: Initialize first durable lineage exactly once from the canonical owner-scoped Project `repository_ref` through existing project-authorized GitHub read actions and #70 concrete client boundary.
validations: AC-04: validate protected requirement — The initial lineage `source_ref_digest` is the SHA-256 of the deterministic protected `repository_ref@provider_revision` reference. Publication can re-prove the expected parent revision by resolving the repository and matching this digest; no new durable lineage field or migration is required.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Protected IMPLEMENT advances the exact bootstrapped lineage using existing expected-parent CAS semantics. BUILD/TEST/VERIFY execute only on that accepted implementation lineage using #69. Fresh repository checkout or unrelated lineage fallback after IMPLEMENT is forbidden.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Delivery is callable only after protected VERIFY succeeds and its server-owned evidence binds the same canonical Project/run and exact accepted source lineage. Pre-IMPLEMENT, parent/root, unverified, stale, forged, or unrelated lineage publication is rejected before provider mutation.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Publication reconstructs the exact accepted durable lineage into disposable server-owned materialization, verifies Project/run/lineage/content digest/file manifest, and converts only that verified content into bounded existing `GitHubCommitFile` values. Local materialization is never durable authority and is always cleaned up.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Delivery uses only existing authorized GitHub branch-create, accepted-lineage commit, PR-create, and PR-read actions. Branch identity is deterministic and bounded; commit uses the re-proven bootstrap provider revision as exact expected parent. Moved/stale parent, repository mismatch, PR/head mismatch, authority denial, credential denial, or provider failure fails closed. Existing replay semantics prevent duplicate branch/commit/PR creation.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — After exact GitHub commit/PR validation, delivery uses only existing authorized Vercel Preview create/read actions with the exact canonical Project/repository, committed source revision, deterministic branch, accepted lineage, and registered Vercel Preview target. Production branch/target/promotion/alias/domain/environment/secret mutation remains impossible. Existing replay semantics prevent duplicate previews.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Success returns only bounded Project/run/repository identity digest, lineage ID/content digest, branch/commit/PR identifiers, preview deployment status/identity and safe URLs through existing provider evidence. Credential material, headers and raw provider payloads are absent. Denial/failure remains structurally distinct from success and is never recorded as release/promotion/deployment success.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Tests cover first bootstrap, repeated bootstrap, independent process/allocator recreation, cross-project/repository mismatch, competing initial source, stale provider parent, exact provider retry/idempotency, verified-lineage-only publication, credential/authority denial, cleanup, and Preview-only ceiling.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Candidate contains approved spec + authentic committed DSPy plan before implementation, only declared composition/test changes, exact-head Workstream Spec Validation/P2 CI/Bounded Autonomy success, and an open PR targeting `integration/wave2-app-builder`. Worker does not merge, deploy, apply migrations, provision production credentials/storage/targets, or edit authoritative project records.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Canonical owner-scoped bootstrap binding
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A first-run bootstrap derives `ProjectRunIdentity` only from persisted `EngineeringRun.project_id` + `EngineeringRun.id`, resolves that Project for the authenticated owner, and requires the Project's canonical GitHub `repository_ref`. Cross-owner/missing/repository-mismatch cases fail closed.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Authorized repository-backed source provider
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Bootstrap source is obtained only through existing project-scoped GitHub provider actions and the accepted concrete GitHub credential/client boundary. Repository resolve/tree/file reads bind one immutable provider revision and return a bounded `SourcePackage`; no URL/clone/Git/shell/generic HTTP/caller-selected revision path exists.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Durable first-lineage CAS and replay
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: When no current lineage exists, the allocator initializes exactly once through #68 durable lineage storage. Same-source retry and process recreation resolve the same accepted lineage; a different/conflicting initializer or stale identity fails closed without replacing current lineage.

critique: The single most material implementation risk or omission in the approved software specification is the lack of a durable lineage storage mechanism. This is a critical issue that needs to be addressed to ensure that the implementation adheres to the specified requirements and does not introduce new risks.
